reason: teniola is a registered local anatomy class. The word is the Latin name of that part and the target is the same class. I did not check its definition.
Latin genitive form of teniola.
taeniola is a spelling variant of teniola.
Genitive of the taeniola spelling variant.
tegula is a registered local class. The word means this part of the pollinarium in orchids.
In orchids the tegular stipe is the tegula, the strap that attaches the pollinia to the viscidium.
The anther wing is a registered local class and the word means it.
An anther flange is a wing-like outgrowth of the anther, the same part as an anther wing.
In Apocynaceae the guide rails are formed by anther wings. I did not check the definition of the target.
A flowering stem is the stem of the reproductive shoot, and the container matches.
A leaf cell is a plant cell that is part of a leaf.
Exothecial cells are cells of the exothecium.
A bract lobe is a lamina lobe of a bract.
The phyllary is the involucral bract, so its apex is the bract apex. The container matches.
A lobe of the lower lip of the corolla is a corolla lobe that is part of a corolla lip. The word 'lower' is not kept.
A leaf base cell is a cell of the leaf base. This is common in mosses.
Costal cells are the cells of the costa (midrib) in mosses.
The base of a style is a plant organ base that is part of the style.
A lamina cell is a cell of the leaf blade. The leaf container is slightly broader but still right.
The phyllary is the involucral bract, so its margin is the bract margin.
A leaf margin cell is a cell at the margin of the leaf.
A bracteole lobe is a lamina lobe of a bracteole.
Stipe scales on ferns are trichomes of the stalk. PO lists scale as a trichome synonym, and the word 'stipe' removes the ambiguity.

Lamellae are plates of cells on the leaf surface, as in Polytrichaceae. A lamella cell is not simply a cell of the costa. The container drops the lamella and may be wrong, so use no container or reject.
A costa cell is a cell of the costa.
Bulb scales are scale leaves of the bulb.
A segment of a bract is a lobe or division of the bract blade. Segments are cut deeper than lobes, so some detail is lost.
A lemma lobe is a lamina lobe of the lemma.
The apex of a pinnule is a plant organ apex that is part of the pinnule.
A central spine is the spine in the middle of a cactus areole. The spines come from the areole bud.
A lateral lobe of the lower lip is a corolla lobe. The words 'lower' and 'lateral' are not kept.
Basal laminal cells are cells of the leaf blade near the base.
A corolla bud is the corolla while still in the bud. The target is the corolla part of a flower bud.
Scales on the leaf blade are trichomes of the lamina, and 'leaf blade' removes the ambiguity of 'scale'.
An exothecium cell is a cell of the exothecium.
A utricle is a perigynium only in Carex and related Cyperaceae. In Amaranthaceae and others it is a fruit. A beak is also not the same as an apex. Reject, or limit the rule to Cyperaceae.
The rachis of a pinna is a leaf rachis that is part of the pinna.
The middle lobe of the lower lip is a corolla lobe. The words 'lower' and 'middle' are not kept.
The base of a raceme is a plant organ base that is part of the raceme.
Leaf border cells are the cells at the leaf margin, which are cells of the leaf.
Medulla is a synonym of pith in PO, so a medulla cell is a pith cell.

The peristome membrane, in mosses the basal membrane of the endostome, is a part of the peristome. It is not the base of the peristome, so the plant organ base target is wrong. Reject, or map to the peristome itself and lose the part.
The rachilla extension is the prolongation of the rachilla beyond the last floret, so it is the apex of the rachilla.
The leaf sheath is the leaf base, so a sheath cell is a leaf base cell.
Marginal lamina cells are cells at the margin of the leaf blade.
A lobe of the lower lip is a corolla lobe. In orchids the labellum would be used instead, so confidence is lower.
Perichaetial leaves are the perichaetal bracts, so their cells are cells of that bract.
A sporangial stalk is the stalk of a sporangium, and the container matches.

'Capsule cell' is any cell of a capsule. Angiosperm capsules and moss capsule interior cells (spores, columella) are not exothecial cells. Use a plain plant cell, or keep the container only for the moss capsule wall.
Basal leaf cells are cells of the leaf near the base. The container 'leaf' is broader but still right.
